title: Monster Speed V3 Step 3 — Fast PR lane + full merge lane
root_cause: The required PR gate waited on browser QA and sport-critical suites even for routine presentation/control-plane edits, so branches spent merge-blocking time proving expensive contracts that can be re-certified immediately on the merged main revision.
patch: Create an explicit lightweight PR certification lane, move browser and routine sport-critical suites to merged-main/full mode, retain full sport proof for high-risk model PRs, run targeted CI on main, and make the final gate aggregate the active mode.
